attchmntText: Rmc Switchgears Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: RMC Switchgears Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 8,890.79 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and Rs. 12,604.70 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 831.74 lakhs, while the half year profit after tax stood at Rs. 1,039.97 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 7.87. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s Rakesh Ashok & Co., Chartered Accountants. The company also allotted 5,020 equity shares under its Employee Stock Option Scheme, 2024, on May 8, 2026.

attchmntText: Rmc Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: RMC Switchgears Limited received Letters of Award from M.P. Poorv Kshetra Vidhyut Vitraran Co. Ltd. for the supply of L.T. Distribution Boxes. The total order value is Rs. 3,93,69,826.47. The contract is with a domestic entity. Execution is required within 36 months. The promoter group has no interest in the awarding entity. The order does not constitute a related party transaction. The company states this strengthens its order book and contributes to revenue growth. Further material developments will be updated as required under SEBI regulations.
